title: Glessner's 18th Street gable window widened to the photographs
items: The tall arched window high in the Glessner house's 18th Street gable is now 2.1 ft wide instead of 1.5, as two survey photographs from 1963 and 1965 show it. Its round top stays at the same height, and the fan of radiating stones over it is a little wider to match.
